question: Does cross-family exposure improve a matched four-trajectory 2D AE and its learned top-5 influence edges on unseen noisy-LJ graphs?

ae_scopes.shared4: one trajectory from each of Reid, low-T, mixed-T, and noisy-LJ

matched.architecture: 2D attention AE, hidden 128, 32 tokens, five edge channels

lj_graph_augmentation: physical graph plus graph-distance-two/three relations at every stage
planned_edge_rule: top five nonphysical partners per node from frozen latent perturbation response
planned_downstream: same normalized acceleration GNN; observe frames 0..3 and autonomously predict through frame 100
